unit-circle.definition:
在平面直角坐标系中，以原点 $O$ 为圆心、半径为 $1$ 的圆称为**单位圆**，方程为

$$x^2 + y^2 = 1$$

从 $x$ 轴正半轴出发逆时针转过角 $\theta$，终边与单位圆的交点坐标恰好是 $(\cos\theta, \sin\theta)$。

这就是三角函数的**单位圆定义**：它把三角函数从「直角三角形的边长之比」推广到了一切实数的角，是理解周期性、诱导公式的关键工具。
unit-circle.definitionEn:
In the Cartesian plane, the circle centered at the origin $O$ with radius $1$ is the **unit circle**, with equation

$$x^2 + y^2 = 1$$

Starting from the positive x-axis and rotating counterclockwise by an angle $\theta$, the terminal side meets the unit circle at the point $(\cos\theta, \sin\theta)$.

This is the **unit-circle definition** of the trigonometric functions: it extends them from ratios of triangle sides to all real angles and is the key to understanding periodicity and the reduction formulas.
derivation: 在平面直角坐标系中，单位圆是 $x^2+y^2=1$。把角 $\theta$ 放在标准位置：顶点在原点，始边为 $x$ 轴正半轴，逆时针为正。终边是一条从原点出发的射线，它与单位圆恰有一个交点 $P(\theta)=(x,y)$。这是因为射线与圆至多交于一点，且从圆心出发的射线必与圆相交。

对任意实数 $\theta$，定义
$$\cos\theta=x,\qquad \sin\theta=y,\qquad \tan\theta=\frac{y}{x}\ (x\ne0).$$
因为 $\theta$ 与 $\theta+2k\pi$ 的终边相同，所以 $\sin,\cos$ 以 $2\pi$ 为周期；$\tan$ 在 $x=0$ 即 $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}+k\pi$ 时无定义，而在其余点以 $\pi$ 为周期。在第一象限，向 $x$ 轴作垂线得到直角三角形，邻边为 $x$、对边为 $y$、斜边为 $1$，故这个定义与锐角三角函数的边比定义一致。

点 $P(\theta)=(x,y)$ 在单位圆上，所以 $x^2+y^2=1$。代入定义得
$$\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta=1.$$
因此 $|\sin\theta|\le1,\ |\cos\theta|\le1$，且等号只在圆与坐标轴的交点处取得。当 $\cos\theta\ne0$ 时，$\tan\theta=\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}$；由 $x^2+y^2=1$ 还可推出 $1+\tan^2\theta=\sec^2\theta$，其中 $\sec\theta=\dfrac{1}{\cos\theta}$（$\cos\theta\ne0$）。

设 $P(\theta)$ 在第 $k$ 象限，则 $x,y$ 的符号由所在象限决定，从而决定三个函数的符号：
- 第一象限 $x>0,y>0$：$\sin>0,\cos>0,\tan>0$；
- 第二象限 $x<0,y>0$：$\sin>0,\cos<0,\tan<0$；
- 第三象限 $x<0,y<0$：$\sin<0,\cos<0,\tan>0$；
- 第四象限 $x>0,y<0$：$\sin<0,\cos>0,\tan<0$。
在坐标轴上，$x=0$ 时 $\tan$ 无定义，$y=0$ 时 $\sin=0$；例如 $\theta=0$ 时 $P=(1,0)$，$\sin0=0,\cos0=1$。

设 $\theta$ 的终边与 $x$ 轴所夹的最小非负角为 $\alpha$（参考角，$0\le\alpha\le\dfrac{\pi}{2}$），则 $P(\theta)$ 与 $P(\alpha)$、$P(\pi-\alpha)$、$P(\pi+\alpha)$ 或 $P(2\pi-\alpha)$ 之一的坐标绝对值相同，故在 $\tan\theta$ 有定义时
$$|\sin\theta|=\sin\alpha,\qquad |\cos\theta|=\cos\alpha,\qquad |\tan\theta|=\tan\alpha.$$
符号再按 $\theta$ 所在象限确定。例如 $\theta=\dfrac{5\pi}{6}$ 在第二象限，参考角 $\alpha=\dfrac{\pi}{6}$，所以 $\sin\dfrac{5\pi}{6}=\dfrac12$，$\cos\dfrac{5\pi}{6}=-\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$，$\tan\dfrac{5\pi}{6}=-\dfrac{\sqrt3}{3}$。

由直角三角形或单位圆的对称性可得特殊角的坐标：
$$P(0)=(1,0),\qquad P\!\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)=\left(\frac{\sqrt3}{2},\frac12\right),$$
$$P\!\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\left(\frac{\sqrt2}{2},\frac{\sqrt2}{2}\right),\qquad P\!\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=\left(\frac12,\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right),$$
$$P\!\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=(0,1).$$
其余特殊角由对称性与周期性得到，例如 $P(\pi)=(-1,0)$，$P\!\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}\right)=(0,-1)$。因此 $\sin0=0,\cos0=1$，$\sin\dfrac{\pi}{2}=1,\cos\dfrac{\pi}{2}=0$，而 $\tan\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 无定义；这些值应结合直角三角形与象限符号记忆，不能只记分母。
derivationEn: In the Cartesian plane the unit circle is $x^2+y^2=1$. Place angle $\theta$ in standard position: vertex at the origin, initial side the positive $x$-axis, counterclockwise positive. The terminal side is a ray from the origin and meets the unit circle in exactly one point $P(\theta)=(x,y)$. This is because a ray meets a circle in at most one point, and a ray from the centre must meet the circle.

For every real $\theta$, define
$$\cos\theta=x,\qquad \sin\theta=y,\qquad \tan\theta=\frac{y}{x}\ (x\ne0).$$
Since $\theta$ and $\theta+2k\pi$ have the same terminal side, $\sin$ and $\cos$ have period $2\pi$; $\tan$ is undefined when $x=0$, i.e. $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}+k\pi$, and on its domain has period $\pi$. In the first quadrant, dropping a perpendicular to the $x$-axis gives a right triangle with adjacent side $x$, opposite side $y$ and hypotenuse $1$, so this definition agrees with the right-triangle ratio definition.

The point $P(\theta)=(x,y)$ lies on the unit circle, so $x^2+y^2=1$. Substituting the definitions gives
$$\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta=1.$$
Hence $|\sin\theta|\le1$ and $|\cos\theta|\le1$, with equality only at the intersections of the circle with the axes. When $\cos\theta\ne0$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}$; from $x^2+y^2=1$ one also gets $1+\tan^2\theta=\sec^2\theta$, where $\sec\theta=\dfrac{1}{\cos\theta}$ (for $\cos\theta\ne0$).

Let $\alpha$ be the smallest non-negative angle between the terminal side of $\theta$ and the $x$-axis (the reference angle, $0\le\alpha\le\dfrac{\pi}{2}$). Then $P(\theta)$ has the same coordinate magnitudes as one of $P(\alpha)$, $P(\pi-\alpha)$, $P(\pi+\alpha)$ or $P(2\pi-\alpha)$, so whenever $\tan\theta$ is defined,
$$|\sin\theta|=\sin\alpha,\qquad |\cos\theta|=\cos\alpha,\qquad |\tan\theta|=\tan\alpha.$$
The signs are then fixed by the quadrant of $\theta$. For example, $\theta=\dfrac{5\pi}{6}$ lies in quadrant II with reference angle $\alpha=\dfrac{\pi}{6}$, so $\sin\dfrac{5\pi}{6}=\dfrac12$, $\cos\dfrac{5\pi}{6}=-\dfrac{\sqrt3}{2}$, and $\tan\dfrac{5\pi}{6}=-\dfrac{\sqrt3}{3}$.

Right triangles or the symmetry of the circle give the coordinates of the special angles:
$$P(0)=(1,0),\qquad P\!\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)=\left(\frac{\sqrt3}{2},\frac12\right),$$
$$P\!\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=\left(\frac{\sqrt2}{2},\frac{\sqrt2}{2}\right),\qquad P\!\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right)=\left(\frac12,\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right),$$
$$P\!\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=(0,1).$$
The remaining special angles follow by symmetry and periodicity, e.g. $P(\pi)=(-1,0)$ and $P\!\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}\right)=(0,-1)$. Hence $\sin0=0,\cos0=1$, $\sin\dfrac{\pi}{2}=1,\cos\dfrac{\pi}{2}=0$, while $\tan\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ is undefined; these values should be tied to right triangles and quadrant signs, not memorized from denominators alone.

triangle.definition:
由不在同一直线上的三条线段首尾顺次相接组成的封闭图形叫做**三角形**。三个内角之和恒为 $180^\circ$，即 $\pi$ 弧度。

三角形是解三角形与三角学的起点：正弦定理、余弦定理、面积公式都建立在它的边角关系之上。按角可分为锐角、直角、钝角三角形；按边可分为等边、等腰、不等边三角形。
triangle.definitionEn:
A **triangle** is the closed figure formed by three line segments joining three non-collinear points. Its three interior angles always sum to $180^\circ$, i.e. $\pi$ radians.

Triangles are the starting point of trigonometry: the law of sines, the law of cosines, and the area formulas all rest on their side-angle relations. They are classified by angles (acute, right, obtuse) or by sides (equilateral, isosceles, scalene).
derivation: 设 $A,B,C$ 是不共线的三点，顺次连接 $AB,BC,CA$ 得到三角形 $ABC$。记 $a=BC,\ b=CA,\ c=AB$，并记 $A,B,C$ 处的内角分别为同名字母。三边为正；任意两边之和大于第三边是必然结论，下面先证明内角和定理，再证明三边关系。

过 $C$ 作直线 $DE\parallel AB$，使 $D,C,E$ 依次共线。因为 $AB\parallel DE$，内错角相等，所以 $\angle DCA=\angle CAB=A$，$\angle ECB=\angle CBA=B$。又 $A,B$ 在直线 $DE$ 的同侧，射线 $CA,CB$ 落在同一半平面内，故 $\angle DCA+\angle ACB+\angle BCE=\pi$，即 $A+B+C=\pi$。
延长 $BC$ 到 $F$，使 $C$ 在 $B,F$ 之间，则 $\angle ACF=\pi-\angle ACB=A+B$：三角形的一个外角等于与它不相邻的两个内角之和。由此 $A+B<\pi$，每个内角都在 $(0,\pi)$ 内；若有一个角 $\ge\pi/2$，另外两角之和便 $\le\pi/2$，所以一个三角形至多有一个直角或钝角。

对任意两点 $B,C$，线段 $BC$ 是连接它们的最短路径。若 $A$ 不在直线 $BC$ 上，则折线 $B\to A\to C$ 严格长于 $BC$，即 $a=BC<BA+AC=c+b$。同理 $b<a+c$，$c<a+b$。等号只在 $A$ 位于线段 $BC$ 上（$B,A,C$ 依次共线）时成立；若 $A$ 在直线 $BC$ 上但在线段外，则 $BA+AC>BC$。此时图形退化，不构成三角形。

由 $a<b+c$、$b<a+c$ 与 $c<a+b$ 得 $|b-c|<a<b+c$；轮换字母即得三组不等式。反过来，若正数 $a,b,c$ 满足这三组不等式，取长度为 $b,c$ 的两边并使夹角 $A\in(0,\pi)$，由余弦定理 $a^2=b^2+c^2-2bc\cos A$。当 $A$ 从 $0$ 变到 $\pi$ 时，右端从 $(b-c)^2$ 连续增大到 $(b+c)^2$，故存在唯一 $A$ 使等式成立，三角形存在。

设 $a>b$，在 $CB$ 上取点 $D$ 使 $CD=CA=b$（因 $b<a$，$D$ 在 $C,B$ 之间）。则 $\triangle ACD$ 等腰，$\angle CAD=\angle CDA$；又 $D$ 在 $CB$ 内部，$\angle CAD<\angle CAB=A$。而 $\angle CDA$ 是 $\triangle ABD$ 在 $D$ 处的外角，故 $\angle CDA=\angle DAB+\angle ABD>\angle ABD=B$。于是 $A>B$，即大边对大角。反之若 $A>B$，比较 $a,b$ 的三种情形 $a<b,a=b,a>b$：前两种分别推出 $A<B$（大边对大角）或 $A=B$（等腰三角形底角相等），均矛盾，故只能 $a>b$，即大角对大边。
derivationEn: Let $A,B,C$ be three non-collinear points, and join $AB,BC,CA$ in order to form triangle $ABC$. Write $a=BC,\ b=CA,\ c=AB$, and denote the interior angles at $A,B,C$ by the same letters. The sides are positive; the fact that any two exceed the third will be proved below, after the angle-sum theorem.

Draw the line $DE$ through $C$ parallel to $AB$, with $D,C,E$ collinear in that order. Since $AB\parallel DE$, alternate interior angles are equal, so $\angle DCA=\angle CAB=A$ and $\angle ECB=\angle CBA=B$. Also $A$ and $B$ lie on the same side of $DE$, so the rays $CA,CB$ lie in the same half-plane and $\angle DCA+\angle ACB+\angle BCE=\pi$, hence $A+B+C=\pi$.

Extend $BC$ to $F$ with $C$ between $B$ and $F$. Then $\angle ACF=\pi-\angle ACB=A+B$: an exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the two non-adjacent interior angles. Hence $A+B<\pi$ and every interior angle lies in $(0,\pi)$; if one angle is $\ge\pi/2$, the other two sum to $\le\pi/2$, so a triangle has at most one right or obtuse angle.

For any two points $B,C$, the segment $BC$ is the shortest path between them. If $A$ is not on line $BC$, the broken path $B\to A\to C$ is strictly longer than $BC$, so $a=BC<BA+AC=c+b$. Similarly $b<a+c$ and $c<a+b$. Equality holds only when $A$ lies on segment $BC$ ($B,A,C$ collinear in that order); if $A$ is on line $BC$ but outside the segment, then $BA+AC>BC$. That is a degenerate case, not a triangle.

From $a<b+c$, $b<a+c$ and $c<a+b$ we get $|b-c|<a<b+c$; permuting the letters gives all three inequalities. Conversely, if positive $a,b,c$ satisfy these three inequalities, take sides of lengths $b,c$ with included angle $A\in(0,\pi)$. The law of cosines gives $a^2=b^2+c^2-2bc\cos A$. As $A$ runs from $0$ to $\pi$, the right side increases continuously from $(b-c)^2$ to $(b+c)^2$, so a unique $A$ makes the equality hold and a triangle exists.

Suppose $a>b$. Choose $D$ on $CB$ with $CD=CA=b$; since $b<a$, $D$ lies between $C$ and $B$. Then $\triangle ACD$ is isosceles, so $\angle CAD=\angle CDA$; since $D$ lies inside $CB$, $\angle CAD<\angle CAB=A$. But $\angle CDA$ is an exterior angle of $\triangle ABD$ at $D$, hence $\angle CDA=\angle DAB+\angle ABD>\angle ABD=B$. Therefore $A>B$: the larger side is opposite the larger angle. Conversely, if $A>B$, compare $a$ and $b$ in the three cases $a<b,a=b,a>b$: the first two imply $A<B$ (larger side, larger angle) or $A=B$ (equal sides, equal base angles), both contradictions, so $a>b$; the larger angle is opposite the larger side.

angle-radian.definition:
**角**可以看成一条射线绕它的端点旋转形成的图形：旋转方向逆时针时角为正，顺时针时为负，这样角就可以取任意大小的实数，不再限于 $0^\circ$ 到 $360^\circ$。所有与角 $\alpha$ 终边相同的角组成一个集合 $\{\beta \mid \beta = \alpha + k\cdot 360^\circ,\ k \in \mathbb{Z}\}$。

**弧度制**换了一种度量方式：长度等于半径的弧所对的圆心角叫做 $1$ 弧度的角，记作 $1\,\mathrm{rad}$。一个周角是 $360^\circ$，而它的弧长是 $2\pi r$，所以 $360^\circ = 2\pi$ 弧度，即 $180^\circ = \pi$ 弧度。

弧度制的最大好处是把角与实数一一对应，使角成为真正可以当作自变量参与运算的量，从而使三角函数成为实数集上的函数，也是后面导数公式 $\dfrac{d}{dx}\sin x = \cos x$ 成立的前提。

扇形中的三个量 $l = |\alpha| r$、$S = \dfrac{1}{2} l r = \dfrac{1}{2} |\alpha| r^2$ 在弧度制下形式极其简洁，这也是弧度制被广泛使用的原因之一。
angle-radian.definitionEn:
An **angle** can be viewed as a ray rotating about its endpoint: counterclockwise rotation gives a positive angle, clockwise gives a negative one. In this way an angle can be any real number and is no longer limited to $0^\circ$ to $360^\circ$. All angles sharing the same terminal side with $\alpha$ form the set $\{\beta \mid \beta = \alpha + k\cdot 360^\circ,\ k \in \mathbb{Z}\}$.

**Radian measure** is another way to measure an angle: the central angle subtended by an arc equal in length to the radius is called an angle of $1$ radian, written $1\,\mathrm{rad}$. A full turn is $360^\circ$ and its arc length is $2\pi r$, so $360^\circ = 2\pi$ radians, i.e. $180^\circ = \pi$ radians.

The great advantage of radians is that they put angles in one-to-one correspondence with real numbers, so an angle becomes a genuine independent variable. This is what makes the trigonometric functions functions on the reals, and it is exactly why the derivative formula $\dfrac{d}{dx}\sin x = \cos x$ holds.

For a sector, the three quantities take their cleanest form in radians: $l = |\alpha| r$ and $S = \dfrac{1}{2} l r = \dfrac{1}{2} |\alpha| r^2$.
derivation: 把角看成射线绕端点 $O$ 从始边旋转到终边的过程：逆时针为正，顺时针为负，因此角可取任意实数。若角 $\alpha$ 的终边与 $\beta$ 的终边重合，则 $\beta=\alpha+2k\pi,\ k\in\mathbb Z$（角度制写作 $\alpha+k\cdot360^\circ$）。弧度制用弧长与半径之比来度量角：长度等于半径的弧所对的圆心角规定为 $1$ 弧度。

半径为 $r$ 的圆，周长为 $2\pi r$，所以整个周角对应的弧长与半径之比为 $2\pi r/r=2\pi$。因此周角既是 $360^\circ$ 又是 $2\pi$ 弧度：
$$360^\circ=2\pi\ \mathrm{rad},\qquad 180^\circ=\pi\ \mathrm{rad}.$$
两边除以 $180$ 得 $1^\circ=\dfrac{\pi}{180}$ 弧度；除以 $\pi$ 得 $1$ 弧度 $=\dfrac{180^\circ}{\pi}\approx57.2958^\circ$。弧度是长度之比，故无量纲，书写时通常省略单位。

设圆心角为 $\theta$（弧度，$0<\theta\le2\pi$），半径为 $r$，所对弧长为 $l$。整个圆的弧长 $2\pi r$ 对应圆心角 $2\pi$，按比例
$$\frac{l}{2\pi r}=\frac{\theta}{2\pi}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad l=r\theta.$$
当角为负时弧长取正，公式改为 $l=r|\theta|$；当 $\theta$ 用角度制时，$l=\dfrac{\pi r|\theta|}{180^\circ}$；若限定 $\theta>0$，可省略绝对值。

同样按比例，扇形面积 $S$ 占整个圆面积 $\pi r^2$ 的比例等于圆心角占 $2\pi$ 的比例：
$$\frac{S}{\pi r^2}=\frac{\theta}{2\pi}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad S=\frac12 r^2\theta.$$
又 $l=r\theta$，所以 $S=\dfrac12 lr$。若 $\theta$ 为负，取 $S=\dfrac12r^2|\theta|$。这里 $\theta$ 必须是该扇形所对的圆心角，且通常取 $0<\theta\le2\pi$；当 $\theta>2\pi$ 时扇形会重叠，比例推导不再直接适用。

终边相同的角相差 $2\pi$ 的整数倍，因此 $\sin,\cos,\tan$ 的值相同（正切还需两边都有定义）。任一角 $\alpha$ 都可唯一写成 $\alpha=\alpha_0+2k\pi$，其中 $k\in\mathbb Z$，主值 $\alpha_0\in[0,2\pi)$；若采用 $(-\pi,\pi]$ 作主值区间，写法会相应改变。例如 $\dfrac{7\pi}{3}=\dfrac{\pi}{3}+2\pi$，与 $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ 终边相同；$-\dfrac{\pi}{4}$ 与 $\dfrac{7\pi}{4}$ 终边相同。

例：半径 $r=3$、圆心角 $\theta=\dfrac{2\pi}{3}$ 的扇形，弧长 $l=3\cdot\dfrac{2\pi}{3}=2\pi$，面积 $S=\dfrac12\cdot3^2\cdot\dfrac{2\pi}{3}=3\pi$，也可用 $S=\dfrac12lr=\dfrac12\cdot2\pi\cdot3=3\pi$ 检验。若误把 $\theta=120^\circ$ 直接代入 $l=r\theta$，数值上会得到 $3\times120=360$，说明公式只适用于弧度；正确做法是先化 $120^\circ=\dfrac{2\pi}{3}$。
derivationEn: Regard an angle as a ray rotating about its endpoint $O$ from an initial side to a terminal side: counterclockwise is positive and clockwise negative, so angles can be any real number. If $\alpha$ and $\beta$ have the same terminal side, then $\beta=\alpha+2k\pi,\ k\in\mathbb Z$ (in degrees, $\alpha+k\cdot360^\circ$). Radian measure uses the ratio of arc length to radius: the central angle subtending an arc equal to the radius is defined to be $1$ radian.

A circle of radius $r$ has circumference $2\pi r$, so a full turn corresponds to the ratio $2\pi r/r=2\pi$. Hence a full turn is both $360^\circ$ and $2\pi$ radians:
$$360^\circ=2\pi\ \mathrm{rad},\qquad 180^\circ=\pi\ \mathrm{rad}.$$
Dividing by $180$ gives $1^\circ=\dfrac{\pi}{180}$ rad; dividing by $\pi$ gives $1$ rad $=\dfrac{180^\circ}{\pi}\approx57.2958^\circ$. A radian is a ratio of lengths, hence dimensionless, and the unit is usually omitted.

Let the central angle be $\theta$ (radians, $0<\theta\le2\pi$), the radius $r$, and the subtended arc length $l$. The full circumference $2\pi r$ corresponds to angle $2\pi$, so by proportion
$$\frac{l}{2\pi r}=\frac{\theta}{2\pi}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad l=r\theta.$$
For a negative angle the length is positive and the formula becomes $l=r|\theta|$. If $\theta$ is in degrees, $l=\dfrac{\pi r|\theta|}{180^\circ}$; if $\theta>0$ is assumed, the absolute value may be omitted.

Likewise, the sector area $S$ is to the full area $\pi r^2$ as the central angle is to $2\pi$:
$$\frac{S}{\pi r^2}=\frac{\theta}{2\pi}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad S=\frac12 r^2\theta.$$
Since $l=r\theta$, also $S=\dfrac12 lr$. For $\theta<0$ use $S=\dfrac12r^2|\theta|$. Here $\theta$ must be the central angle subtending that sector, normally $0<\theta\le2\pi$; for $\theta>2\pi$ the sector overlaps itself and the proportion argument no longer applies directly.

Coterminal angles differ by an integer multiple of $2\pi$, so $\sin,\cos,\tan$ take the same values (for tangent, provided both expressions are defined). Every angle $\alpha$ can be written uniquely as $\alpha=\alpha_0+2k\pi$ with $k\in\mathbb Z$ and principal value $\alpha_0\in[0,2\pi)$; using $(-\pi,\pi]$ as the principal interval changes the representative accordingly. For example, $\dfrac{7\pi}{3}=\dfrac{\pi}{3}+2\pi$ has the same terminal side as $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$, and $-\dfrac{\pi}{4}$ has the same terminal side as $\dfrac{7\pi}{4}$.

Example: for a sector with $r=3$ and $\theta=\dfrac{2\pi}{3}$, the arc length is $l=3\cdot\dfrac{2\pi}{3}=2\pi$ and the area is $S=\dfrac12\cdot3^2\cdot\dfrac{2\pi}{3}=3\pi$; the alternative $S=\dfrac12lr=\dfrac12\cdot2\pi\cdot3=3\pi$ checks it. Substituting $\theta=120^\circ$ directly into $l=r\theta$ would give the numerical value $3\times120=360$, showing that the formula requires radians; first convert $120^\circ=\dfrac{2\pi}{3}$.

trigonometric-definition.definition:
回忆初中：在直角三角形中，$\sin A = \dfrac{\text{对边}}{\text{斜边}}$，$\cos A = \dfrac{\text{邻边}}{\text{斜边}}$，$\tan A = \dfrac{\text{对边}}{\text{邻边}}$。但这样定义只能处理锐角，无法定义 $150^\circ$ 或 $-\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ 的三角函数值。

**单位圆定义法**解决了这个问题。在平面直角坐标系中作单位圆（半径为 $1$、圆心在原点），设角 $\alpha$ 的终边与单位圆交于点 $P(x, y)$，规定

$$\sin\alpha = y,\qquad \cos\alpha = x,\qquad \tan\alpha = \frac{y}{x}\ (x \neq 0).$$

换句话说，**余弦是横坐标，正弦是纵坐标**。因为点 $P$ 一定在单位圆上，所以 $x^2 + y^2 = 1$，立即得到 $\sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1$。

当 $\alpha$ 是锐角时，取点 $P$ 向 $x$ 轴作垂线得到的直角三角形正好说明：$y$ 是 $\alpha$ 的对边（斜边为 $1$）、$x$ 是邻边，所以新定义与初中定义完全一致——新定义只是推广，并没有改变。
trigonometric-definition.definitionEn:
In junior high we learned that in a right triangle, $\sin A = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$, $\cos A = \dfrac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}}$, $\tan A = \dfrac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}$. But such a definition only handles acute angles; it cannot give a meaning to $\sin 150^\circ$ or $\cos\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)$.

The **unit-circle definition** fixes this. Draw the unit circle (centred at the origin, radius $1$) in the coordinate plane and let the terminal side of angle $\alpha$ meet the circle at $P(x, y)$. Define

$$\sin\alpha = y,\qquad \cos\alpha = x,\qquad \tan\alpha = \frac{y}{x}\ (x \neq 0).$$

In words: **the cosine is the x-coordinate and the sine is the y-coordinate**. Since $P$ lies on the unit circle, $x^2 + y^2 = 1$ immediately, giving $\sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1$.

When $\alpha$ is acute, dropping a perpendicular from $P$ to the x-axis produces a right triangle in which $y$ is the side opposite $\alpha$ (the hypotenuse being $1$) and $x$ is the adjacent side. So the new definition agrees exactly with the old one — it only generalises it.
derivation: 初中用直角三角形边之比定义三角函数，只能处理锐角；要给 $150^\circ$ 或 $-\frac{\pi}{3}$ 这类角赋值，需把角放进坐标系。把角的顶点放在原点、始边与 $x$ 轴正半轴重合，终边与单位圆 $x^2+y^2=1$ 交于 $P(x,y)$，规定 $$\sin\alpha=y,\quad \cos\alpha=x,\quad \tan\alpha=\frac{y}{x}\ (x\ne0).$$ 这里 $x,y$ 可正可负，因此函数值也带符号。

与锐角定义一致：若 $0<\alpha<\frac{\pi}{2}$，从 $P$ 向 $x$ 轴作垂线，得到直角三角形，斜边 $OP=1$，$\alpha$ 的对边长为 $y$、邻边长为 $x$。于是 $\sin\alpha=\frac{y}{1}=y$，$\cos\alpha=\frac{x}{1}=x$，$\tan\alpha=\frac{y}{x}$，与初中定义相同；单位圆定义只是把锐角情形推广到任意角。

与终边所取点无关：若 $Q(x',y')$ 是终边上异于原点的另一点，令 $r=\sqrt{x'^2+y'^2}>0$。由于 $P,Q$ 在同一条射线上且 $|OP|=1$，有 $x'=rx,\ y'=ry$，其中 $r=|OQ|>0$。于是 $$\frac{y'}{r}=y=\sin\alpha,\quad \frac{x'}{r}=x=\cos\alpha.$$ 当 $x\ne0$（即 $\tan\alpha$ 有定义）时，$\frac{y'}{x'}=\frac{y}{x}=\tan\alpha$；若 $x=0$，正切无定义。 所以定义不依赖于终边上点的选取，$r$ 只是把点归一化到单位圆。
符号由象限决定：$\sin\alpha$ 的符号等于 $y$，$\cos\alpha$ 的符号等于 $x$，$\tan\alpha$ 的符号等于 $y/x$。第一象限全正；第二象限只有正弦正；第三象限只有正切正；第四象限只有余弦正。当 $x=0$，即 $\alpha=\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi$ 时 $\tan\alpha$ 无定义，而 $\sin,\cos$ 仍有定义。

有界性与平方关系：$P$ 在单位圆上，故 $x^2+y^2=1$，即 $$\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1.$$ 又 $|x|\le1,|y|\le1$，所以 $-1\le\sin\alpha\le1$、$-1\le\cos\alpha\le1$；而 $\tan\alpha=\frac{y}{x}$ 在每个象限内连续变化，且当 $x\to0$ 时绝对值任意大，故值域为 $\mathbb{R}$。

例：角 $\alpha$ 的终边过 $P(-3,4)$，先求 $r=\sqrt{(-3)^2+4^2}=5$，再按一般点定义得 $$\sin\alpha=\frac{4}{5},\quad \cos\alpha=-\frac{3}{5},\quad \tan\alpha=\frac{4}{-3}=-\frac{4}{3}.$$ 点不在单位圆上时，必须先除以 $r$ 归一化；直接读坐标会使 $\sin\alpha,\cos\alpha$ 放大 $5$ 倍；$\tan\alpha$ 是比值，不受影响。
derivationEn: In junior high, trigonometric functions are defined as ratios of sides in a right triangle, which only covers acute angles. To assign values to angles such as $150^\circ$ or $-\frac{\pi}{3}$, place the angle in the coordinate plane: vertex at the origin, initial side along the positive x-axis, and let the terminal side meet the unit circle $x^2+y^2=1$ at $P(x,y)$. Define $$\sin\alpha=y,\quad \cos\alpha=x,\quad \tan\alpha=\frac{y}{x}\ (x\ne0).$$ Here $x$ and $y$ may be negative, so the values carry signs.

Agreement with the acute-angle definition: if $0<\alpha<\frac{\pi}{2}$, drop a perpendicular from $P$ to the x-axis. The right triangle has hypotenuse $OP=1$, opposite side $y$ and adjacent side $x$. Hence $\sin\alpha=\frac{y}{1}=y$, $\cos\alpha=\frac{x}{1}=x$ and $\tan\alpha=\frac{y}{x}$, exactly the junior-high ratios; the unit-circle definition merely extends them to arbitrary angles.

Independence of the chosen point: let $Q(x',y')$ be another point on the terminal side and put $r=\sqrt{x'^2+y'^2}>0$. Since $P$ and $Q$ lie on the same ray and $|OP|=1$, we have $x'=rx$ and $y'=ry$, where $r=|OQ|>0$. Therefore $$\frac{y'}{r}=y=\sin\alpha,\quad \frac{x'}{r}=x=\cos\alpha.$$ When $x\ne0$ (i.e. $\tan\alpha$ is defined), $\frac{y'}{x'}=\frac{y}{x}=\tan\alpha$; if $x=0$, tangent is undefined. Thus the definition does not depend on the point chosen; dividing by $r$ simply normalises the point to the unit circle.

Signs are determined by the quadrant: the sign of $\sin\alpha$ is that of $y$, of $\cos\alpha$ that of $x$, and of $\tan\alpha$ that of $y/x$. All three are positive in quadrant I; only sine in II; only tangent in III; only cosine in IV. When $x=0$, i.e. $\alpha=\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi$, $\tan\alpha$ is undefined, while $\sin$ and $\cos$ remain defined.

Boundedness and the Pythagorean relation: $P$ lies on the unit circle, so $x^2+y^2=1$, i.e. $$\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1.$$ Since $|x|\le1$ and $|y|\le1$, $-1\le\sin\alpha\le1$ and $-1\le\cos\alpha\le1$. By contrast, $\tan\alpha=y/x$ varies continuously within each quadrant and has arbitrarily large absolute value as $x\to0$, so its range is $\mathbb{R}$.

Example: if the terminal side of $\alpha$ passes through $P(-3,4)$, first compute $r=\sqrt{(-3)^2+4^2}=5$, then use the general-point definition: $$\sin\alpha=\frac{4}{5},\quad \cos\alpha=-\frac{3}{5},\quad \tan\alpha=\frac{4}{-3}=-\frac{4}{3}.$$ For a point not on the unit circle one must divide by $r$ first; reading off the coordinates directly would inflate $\sin\alpha$ and $\cos\alpha$ by a factor of $5$; $\tan\alpha$, being a ratio, is unchanged.

sine-function.definition:
**正弦函数**定义为

$$y = \sin x \quad (x \in \mathbb{R}),$$

即对每个实数 $x$（弧度值），取单位圆上角 $x$ 所对应点的纵坐标。它的图像是一条光滑的波浪曲线，叫做**正弦曲线**（sinusoid）。

正弦函数有两个标志性特征：一是**有界**，输出永远夹在 $-1$ 和 $1$ 之间；二是**周期**，每当自变量增加 $2\pi$，图像就完整重复一次。由于 $\sin(-x) = -\sin x$，它是**奇函数**，图像关于原点中心对称。

正弦曲线是描述一切振动与波动的基本模型：单摆、弹簧、交流电、声波、光波，在理想情形下都是正弦形的。物理学中写成 $A\sin(\omega t + \varphi)$，其中 $A$ 是振幅、$\omega$ 是角频率、$\varphi$ 是初相。

它还有一个漂亮的导数性质：$\dfrac{d}{dx}\sin x = \cos x$，第二次求导就回到 $-\sin x$，这正说明正弦是「振动方程」$y'' + y = 0$ 的解。
sine-function.definitionEn:
The **sine function** is defined by

$$y = \sin x \quad (x \in \mathbb{R}),$$

mapping each real number $x$ (in radians) to the y-coordinate of the corresponding point on the unit circle. Its graph is a smooth wave called a **sine curve** (sinusoid).

Two features define it: it is **bounded**, never leaving $[-1,1]$; and it is **periodic**, the graph repeating itself completely whenever $x$ grows by $2\pi$. Because $\sin(-x) = -\sin x$ it is an **odd function**, symmetric about the origin.

The sine curve is the basic model for every vibration and wave: pendulums, springs, alternating current, sound and light in the ideal case. In physics it appears as $A\sin(\omega t + \varphi)$, where $A$ is the amplitude, $\omega$ the angular frequency and $\varphi$ the initial phase.

It also has a beautiful derivative property: $\dfrac{d}{dx}\sin x = \cos x$, and differentiating twice returns $-\sin x$, showing that the sine solves the oscillation equation $y'' + y = 0$.
derivation: 正弦函数 $y=\sin x$ 对每个实数 $x$（弧度）取单位圆上角 $x$ 对应点的纵坐标，定义域为 $\mathbb{R}$。因该点在单位圆上，纵坐标满足 $-1\le y\le1$，且当 $x=\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi$ 时 $y=1$、当 $x=-\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi$ 时 $y=-1$，故值域为 $[-1,1]$。

周期性：$x$ 与 $x+2k\pi$ 的终边相同，单位圆上对应同一点，所以 $$\sin(x+2k\pi)=\sin x,\quad k\in\mathbb{Z}.$$ 最小正周期是 $2\pi$：若 $T>0$ 是周期，取 $x=0$ 得 $\sin T=0$，故 $T=n\pi$；再取 $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$，得 $\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+n\pi\right)=(-1)^n=1$，所以 $n$ 为偶数，最小正周期 $T=2\pi$。
奇偶性：角 $x$ 对应点 $P=(\cos x,\sin x)$，角 $-x$ 的终边是 $x$ 终边关于 $x$ 轴的对称，故 $P(-x)=(\cos x,-\sin x)$。于是 $$\sin(-x)=-\sin x,$$ 正弦是奇函数，图像关于原点中心对称；特别地 $\sin0=0$。

图像的关键点与单调性：在 $[0,2\pi]$ 上，$\sin0=0$，$\sin\frac{\pi}{6}=\frac12$，$\sin\frac{\pi}{2}=1$，$\sin\frac{5\pi}{6}=\frac12$，$\sin\pi=0$，$\sin\frac{3\pi}{2}=-1$，$\sin2\pi=0$。由 $\frac{d}{dx}\sin x=\cos x$，在 $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi,\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi\right)$ 上 $\cos x>0$，正弦严格递增；在 $\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi,\frac{3\pi}{2}+2k\pi\right)$ 上严格递减。
对称性：由 $\sin(\pi-x)=\sin x$ 及周期性，直线 $x=\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi$ 都是对称轴；由 $\sin(2k\pi-x)=-\sin x$，点 $(k\pi,0)$ 都是对称中心。这两组对称与奇偶性、周期性一致，画图时可先画 $[0,2\pi]$ 上的一拱再平移复制。

一般形式 $y=A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B$（$A\ne0,\omega\ne0$）：由 $-1\le\sin(\omega x+\varphi)\le1$ 得值域 $[B-|A|,B+|A|]$，振幅 $|A|$，周期 $T=\frac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$。例如 $y=3\sin\left(2x-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)+1$ 的振幅为 $3$、周期为 $\pi$、值域为 $[-2,4]$。
derivationEn: The sine function $y=\sin x$ assigns to each real number $x$ (in radians) the y-coordinate of the point at angle $x$ on the unit circle; its domain is $\mathbb{R}$. Since that point lies on the unit circle, $-1\le y\le1$, with $y=1$ at $x=\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi$ and $y=-1$ at $x=-\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi$; hence the range is $[-1,1]$.

Periodicity: $x$ and $x+2k\pi$ have the same terminal side and hence the same point on the unit circle, so $$\sin(x+2k\pi)=\sin x,\quad k\in\mathbb{Z}.$$ The least positive period is $2\pi$: if $T>0$ were a period, taking $x=0$ gives $\sin T=0$, hence $T=n\pi$; taking $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ then gives $\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+n\pi\right)=(-1)^n=1$, so $n$ is even and the least positive period is $T=2\pi$.

Parity: angle $x$ corresponds to the point $P=(\cos x,\sin x)$, and the terminal side of $-x$ is the reflection of that of $x$ in the x-axis, so $P(-x)=(\cos x,-\sin x)$. Therefore $$\sin(-x)=-\sin x,$$ and sine is odd, with a graph symmetric about the origin; in particular $\sin0=0$.

Key points and monotonicity: on $[0,2\pi]$, $\sin0=0$, $\sin\frac{\pi}{6}=\frac12$, $\sin\frac{\pi}{2}=1$, $\sin\frac{5\pi}{6}=\frac12$, $\sin\pi=0$, $\sin\frac{3\pi}{2}=-1$ and $\sin2\pi=0$. Since $\frac{d}{dx}\sin x=\cos x$, sine is strictly increasing on $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi,\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi\right)$, where $\cos x>0$, and strictly decreasing on $\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi,\frac{3\pi}{2}+2k\pi\right)$.

Symmetry: from $\sin(\pi-x)=\sin x$ and periodicity, every line $x=\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi$ is an axis of symmetry; from $\sin(2k\pi-x)=-\sin x$, every point $(k\pi,0)$ is a centre of symmetry. These agree with oddness and periodicity, and one may draw one arch on $[0,2\pi]$ and copy it by translation.

General form $y=A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B$ with $A\ne0$ and $\omega\ne0$: from $-1\le\sin(\omega x+\varphi)\le1$, the range is $[B-|A|,B+|A|]$, the amplitude is $|A|$, and the period is $T=\frac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$. For example, $y=3\sin\left(2x-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)+1$ has amplitude $3$, period $\pi$ and range $[-2,4]$.

cosine-function.definition:
**余弦函数**定义为

$$y = \cos x \quad (x \in \mathbb{R}),$$

即单位圆上角 $x$ 所对应点的横坐标。它的图像叫做**余弦曲线**，形状与正弦曲线完全相同，只是整体向左平移了 $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$：

$$\cos x = \sin\left(x + \frac{\pi}{2}\right).$$

与正弦不同，余弦是**偶函数**：$\cos(-x) = \cos x$，图像关于 $y$ 轴对称（而正弦图像关于原点对称）。在 $x = 0$ 处余弦取到最大值 $1$，正弦则从 $0$ 出发上升。

余弦在几何与物理中的角色同样核心。它是向量点积的组成部分（$\vec a\cdot\vec b = |\vec a||\vec b|\cos\theta$），是傅里叶级数中与正弦配对的另一组基函数，也是描述简谐运动时常用的初相位选择。

它的导数是 $\dfrac{d}{dx}\cos x = -\sin x$——注意那个负号，这正是「余弦过峰值时斜率为零，随后向负方向变化」的体现。
cosine-function.definitionEn:
The **cosine function** is defined by

$$y = \cos x \quad (x \in \mathbb{R}),$$

sending $x$ to the x-coordinate of the corresponding point on the unit circle. Its graph, the **cosine curve**, has exactly the same shape as the sine curve but is shifted left by $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$:

$$\cos x = \sin\left(x + \frac{\pi}{2}\right).$$

Unlike the sine, the cosine is **even**: $\cos(-x) = \cos x$, so its graph is symmetric about the y-axis (while the sine graph is symmetric about the origin). The cosine attains its maximum $1$ at $x = 0$, whereas the sine starts at $0$ and rises.

The cosine plays an equally central role in geometry and physics. It appears in the dot product ($\vec a\cdot\vec b = |\vec a||\vec b|\cos\theta$), it is the partner basis function of the sine in Fourier series, and it is often the natural choice of phase for simple harmonic motion.

Its derivative is $\dfrac{d}{dx}\cos x = -\sin x$ — note the minus sign, which reflects that at its peak the cosine has zero slope and then decreases.
derivation: 余弦函数 $y=\cos x$ 取单位圆上角 $x$ 对应点的横坐标，定义域为 $\mathbb{R}$。因点在单位圆上，$-1\le\cos x\le1$；当 $x=2k\pi$ 时 $\cos x=1$，当 $x=\pi+2k\pi$ 时 $\cos x=-1$，故值域为 $[-1,1]$，最大值在 $x=2k\pi$ 处取得。
偶函数：角 $-x$ 的终边与角 $x$ 的终边关于 $x$ 轴对称，交点由 $(\cos x,\sin x)$ 变为 $(\cos x,-\sin x)$，横坐标不变，所以 $$\cos(-x)=\cos x.$$ 余弦是偶函数，图像关于 $y$ 轴对称；这也解释了为什么 $x=0$ 处取到最大值 $1$。
周期性：$x$ 与 $x+2k\pi$ 对应单位圆上同一点，故 $\cos(x+2k\pi)=\cos x$。最小正周期为 $2\pi$：若 $T>0$ 是周期，取 $x=0$ 得 $\cos T=1$，于是 $T=2k\pi$，最小正值为 $2\pi$。

与正弦的关系：角 $x+\frac{\pi}{2}$ 对应的点为 $\left(-\sin x,\cos x\right)$，其纵坐标是 $\cos x$，故 $$\cos x=\sin\left(x+\frac{\pi}{2}\right).$$ 因此余弦曲线就是正弦曲线向左平移 $\frac{\pi}{2}$；反之 $\sin x=\cos\left(x-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)$。
单调性与极值：由 $\frac{d}{dx}\cos x=-\sin x$，在 $(2k\pi,(2k+1)\pi)$ 上 $\sin x>0$，余弦严格递减；在 $((2k-1)\pi,2k\pi)$ 上 $\sin x<0$，余弦严格递增。于是最大值 $1$ 在 $x=2k\pi$ 取得，最小值 $-1$ 在 $x=(2k+1)\pi$ 取得。

对称性与一般形式：由 $\cos(2k\pi-x)=\cos x$ 得对称轴 $x=k\pi$；由 $\cos((2k+1)\pi-x)=-\cos x$ 得对称中心 $\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi,0\right)$。对 $y=A\cos(\omega x+\varphi)+B$（$A\omega\ne0$），振幅为 $|A|$、周期为 $\frac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$、值域为 $[B-|A|,B+|A|]$。
derivationEn: The cosine function $y=\cos x$ assigns the x-coordinate of the point at angle $x$ on the unit circle; its domain is $\mathbb{R}$. Since the point lies on the unit circle, $-1\le\cos x\le1$; $\cos x=1$ at $x=2k\pi$ and $\cos x=-1$ at $x=\pi+2k\pi$, so the range is $[-1,1]$ and the maximum is attained at $x=2k\pi$.

Evenness: the terminal side of $-x$ is the reflection of that of $x$ in the x-axis, so the intersection point changes from $(\cos x,\sin x)$ to $(\cos x,-\sin x)$; the x-coordinate is unchanged. Hence $$\cos(-x)=\cos x.$$ Cosine is even and its graph is symmetric about the y-axis; this also explains why the maximum $1$ occurs at $x=0$.

Periodicity: $x$ and $x+2k\pi$ correspond to the same point on the unit circle, so $\cos(x+2k\pi)=\cos x$. The least positive period is $2\pi$: if $T>0$ were a period, taking $x=0$ gives $\cos T=1$, hence $T=2k\pi$, whose least positive value is $2\pi$.

Relation to sine: the point at angle $x+\frac{\pi}{2}$ is $\left(-\sin x,\cos x\right)$, whose y-coordinate is $\cos x$, so $$\cos x=\sin\left(x+\frac{\pi}{2}\right).$$ Thus the cosine curve is the sine curve shifted left by $\frac{\pi}{2}$; equivalently, $\sin x=\cos\left(x-\frac{\pi}{2}\right)$.

Monotonicity and extrema: since $\frac{d}{dx}\cos x=-\sin x$, cosine is strictly decreasing on $(2k\pi,(2k+1)\pi)$, where $\sin x>0$, and strictly increasing on $((2k-1)\pi,2k\pi)$, where $\sin x<0$. Hence the maximum $1$ occurs at $x=2k\pi$ and the minimum $-1$ at $x=(2k+1)\pi$.

Symmetry and general form: $\cos(2k\pi-x)=\cos x$ gives the axes of symmetry $x=k\pi$, while $\cos((2k+1)\pi-x)=-\cos x$ gives the centres of symmetry $\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi,0\right)$. For $y=A\cos(\omega x+\varphi)+B$ with $A\omega\ne0$, the amplitude is $|A|$, the period is $\frac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$, and the range is $[B-|A|,B+|A|]$.

tangent-function.definition:
**正切函数**定义为正弦与余弦之商：

$$y = \tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x},\qquad x \neq \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi,\ k \in \mathbb{Z}.$$

由于分母 $\cos x$ 会让整个式子在这些点失效，凡是 $\cos x = 0$ 的地方正切都没有定义，图像在那里出现**竖直渐近线**，函数值冲向正无穷或负无穷。因此正切函数的定义域是「去掉一些点」的实数集，而不是整个 $\mathbb{R}$。

正切的周期只有 $\pi$（而不是 $2\pi$），因为在区间长度 $\pi$ 之内图像已完整重复一次：

$$\tan(x + \pi) = \tan x.$$

它还是**奇函数**：$\tan(-x) = -\tan x$，图像关于原点中心对称。在每个区间 $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi,\ \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\right)$ 上它严格单调递增，值域覆盖全部实数。

几何上正切就是直线的**斜率**：单位圆上与角 $x$ 终边相同的直线斜率恰为 $\tan x$，这也是「正切」这个名字的由来。
tangent-function.definitionEn:
The **tangent function** is defined as the quotient of sine and cosine:

$$y = \tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x},\qquad x \neq \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi,\ k \in \mathbb{Z}.$$

Because the denominator $\cos x$ vanishes at some points, the tangent is undefined wherever $\cos x = 0$; the graph has a **vertical asymptote** there and the values shoot off to $+\infty$ or $-\infty$. Its domain is therefore the real line with those points removed, not all of $\mathbb{R}$.

The tangent has period $\pi$ only (not $2\pi$), because the pattern already repeats within an interval of length $\pi$:

$$\tan(x + \pi) = \tan x.$$

It is also an **odd function**, $\tan(-x) = -\tan x$, with a graph symmetric about the origin. On every interval $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi,\ \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi\right)$ it is strictly increasing, and its range covers every real number.

Geometrically the tangent is a **slope**: the slope of the line along the terminal side of angle $x$ equals $\tan x$, which is exactly where the name comes from.
derivation: 正切定义为正弦与余弦之商：$$y=\tan x=\frac{\sin x}{\cos x},\qquad x\ne\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi,\ k\in\mathbb{Z}.$$ 因为 $\sin,\cos$ 对所有实数有定义，正切的定义域只排除 $\cos x=0$ 的点；在这些点终边落在 $y$ 轴上，横坐标为 $0$，比值 $y/x$ 无意义。
周期性：利用 $\sin(x+\pi)=-\sin x$、$\cos(x+\pi)=-\cos x$，得 $$\tan(x+\pi)=\frac{-\sin x}{-\cos x}=\tan x.$$ 最小正周期是 $\pi$：若 $T>0$ 是周期，取 $x=0$ 得 $\tan T=0$，故 $T=k\pi$，最小正值为 $\pi$，且 $T=\pi$ 确实使等式成立。
奇偶性：$$\tan(-x)=\frac{\sin(-x)}{\cos(-x)}=\frac{-\sin x}{\cos x}=-\tan x,$$ 所以正切是奇函数，图像关于原点中心对称。结合周期 $\pi$，只需画出一个周期内的图像，再向左、右平移复制。

渐近线与值域：当 $x\to\frac{\pi}{2}^-$ 时，$\sin x\to1$、$\cos x\to0^+$，故 $\tan x\to+\infty$；当 $x\to\frac{\pi}{2}^+$ 时，$\cos x\to0^-$，故 $\tan x\to-\infty$。因此直线 $x=\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi$ 都是竖直渐近线，正切无最大值、无最小值，值域为 $\mathbb{R}$。

单调性：在定义域内 $\frac{d}{dx}\tan x=\sec^2x=\frac{1}{\cos^2x}>0$，所以正切在每一个开区间 $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi,\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi\right)$ 上严格递增。但它不是整个定义域上的增函数：例如 $\frac{\pi}{4}<\frac{3\pi}{4}$，而 $\tan\frac{\pi}{4}=1>-1=\tan\frac{3\pi}{4}$。

一切正弦型的波形都可以写成

$$y = A\sin(\omega x + \varphi) + B \quad (A \neq 0,\ \omega > 0).$$

它的图像可以由最基础的 $y = \sin x$ 经过四种变换拼出来：**振幅变换**、**周期变换**、**相位变换**、**上下平移**。

- $A$ 叫**振幅**，把图像纵向拉伸为原来的 $|A|$ 倍，值域变为 $[-|A|, |A|]$；$A<0$ 时还要上下翻转。
- $\omega$ 决定**周期** $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{\omega}$：$\omega > 1$ 图像横向压缩变密，$0 < \omega < 1$ 则横向拉伸变疏。
- $\varphi$ 是**初相**，把图像水平平移 $\left|\dfrac{\varphi}{\omega}\right|$：$\varphi > 0$ 向左移，$\varphi < 0$ 向右移。
- $B$ 把整条曲线上下平移 $B$ 个单位，于是值域变成 $[B-|A|,\ B+|A|]$。

需要注意顺序：横向变换（$\omega$）与水平平移（$\varphi$）的先后会影响对平移量的理解，规范做法是先把 $\omega x + \varphi$ 提出写成 $\omega\left(x + \dfrac{\varphi}{\omega}\right)$，再按「先伸缩后平移」逐步操作。

四个量都可以从图像上直接读出：最高点与最低点的平均值给出 $B$，高度一半给出 $|A|$，相邻两个零点的距离给出半个周期，最先上升到最高点的横坐标给出相位。
trig-transform.definitionEn:
Every sinusoidal wave can be written

$$y = A\sin(\omega x + \varphi) + B \quad (A \neq 0,\ \omega > 0).$$

Its graph is built from the base curve $y = \sin x$ by four transformations: **amplitude**, **period**, **phase** and **vertical shift**.

- $A$ is the **amplitude**: it stretches the graph vertically by $|A|$, making the range $[-|A|, |A|]$; a negative $A$ also flips it vertically.
- $\omega$ fixes the **period** $T = \dfrac{2\pi}{\omega}$: $\omega > 1$ compresses the graph horizontally, $0 < \omega < 1$ stretches it.
- $\varphi$ is the **initial phase**, shifting the graph horizontally by $\left|\dfrac{\varphi}{\omega}\right|$: left for $\varphi > 0$, right for $\varphi < 0$.
- $B$ moves the whole curve up or down by $B$, giving the range $[B-|A|,\ B+|A|]$.

The order matters: horizontal scaling by $\omega$ and the horizontal shift $\varphi$ interact, so the standard trick is to rewrite $\omega x + \varphi$ as $\omega\left(x + \dfrac{\varphi}{\omega}\right)$ before applying the steps.

All four parameters can be read straight off a graph: the average of the highest and lowest values gives $B$, half the height gives $|A|$, the distance between two consecutive zeros gives half a period, and the first maximum fixes the phase.
derivation: 设 $A\ne0$，$\omega>0$，考虑 $$y=A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B.$$ 基准曲线是 $y=\sin x$。四个参数分别控制：振幅 $|A|$、周期 $T=\frac{2\pi}{\omega}$、初相 $\varphi$、竖直平移 $B$。因为 $\sin$ 的值域为 $[-1,1]$，所以整个函数的值域为 $[B-|A|,B+|A|]$。
竖直方向：先把 $y=\sin x$ 纵向拉伸为原来的 $|A|$ 倍；若 $A<0$，再关于 $x$ 轴翻转，得到 $y=A\sin x$。最后整体上移 $B$（$B<0$ 则下移），得 $y=A\sin x+B$。竖直拉伸与竖直平移的次序不能交换：先平移 $B$ 再拉伸会得到 $A\sin x+AB$，一般不等于 $A\sin x+B$。

水平方向：$y=\sin(\omega x)$ 把 $y=\sin x$ 横向压缩为原来的 $\frac{1}{\omega}$ 倍（$\omega>1$ 变密，$0<\omega<1$ 变疏），周期由 $2\pi$ 变为 $\frac{2\pi}{\omega}$。再加入相位：$$y=\sin(\omega x+\varphi)=\sin\left[\omega\left(x+\frac{\varphi}{\omega}\right)\right].$$ 因此图像向左平移 $\frac{\varphi}{\omega}$（$\varphi>0$）或向右平移 $\left|\frac{\varphi}{\omega}\right|$（$\varphi<0$）。平移量是 $\frac{\varphi}{\omega}$，不是 $\varphi$。

两种正确顺序：① 先横向压缩 $x\mapsto\omega x$，再向左平移 $\frac{\varphi}{\omega}$，得 $\sin[\omega(x+\frac{\varphi}{\omega})]=\sin(\omega x+\varphi)$；② 先向左平移 $\varphi$ 得 $\sin(x+\varphi)$，再横向压缩 $x\mapsto\omega x$，得 $\sin(\omega x+\varphi)$。常见错误是先压缩再平移 $\varphi$，那会得到 $\sin(\omega x+\omega\varphi)$，相位多乘了 $\omega$。竖直方向则统一按「先伸缩、后平移」执行。

从图像反推参数：设最高值为 $M$、最低值为 $m$，则 $$B=\frac{M+m}{2},\qquad |A|=\frac{M-m}{2}.$$ 相邻两个最高点（或相邻的极大点与极小点）的横坐标之差给出一个周期（或半个周期），故 $\omega=\frac{2\pi}{T}$。当 $|B|<|A|$ 时，零点间距一般不等于半周期，除非 $B=0$。取 $A>0$；若最高点横坐标为 $x_0$，则 $$\omega x_0+\varphi=\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi,$$ 取使 $\varphi$ 落在指定范围（如 $(-\pi,\pi]$）的值。$(A,\varphi)$ 不唯一：$(-A,\varphi+\pi)$ 表示同一函数。

例：某正弦曲线相邻的最高点为 $(2,3)$，最低点为 $(6,-1)$。则 $$B=\frac{3+(-1)}{2}=1,\qquad |A|=\frac{3-(-1)}{2}=2.$$ 相邻最高点与最低点的横坐标相差 $4$，即半个周期，故 $T=8$，$\omega=\frac{2\pi}{8}=\frac{\pi}{4}$。取 $A=2$，由 $x=2$ 处取最大值：$\frac{\pi}{4}\cdot2+\varphi=\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi$，取 $k=0$ 得 $\varphi=0$。所以 $$y=2\sin\frac{\pi x}{4}+1.$$
derivationEn: Let $A\ne0$ and $\omega>0$, and consider $$y=A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B.$$ The reference curve is $y=\sin x$. The four parameters control the amplitude $|A|$, the period $T=\frac{2\pi}{\omega}$, the initial phase $\varphi$ and the vertical shift $B$. Since $\sin$ has range $[-1,1]$, the range of the whole function is $[B-|A|,B+|A|]$.

Vertical direction: first stretch $y=\sin x$ vertically by the factor $|A|$; if $A<0$, reflect it in the $x$-axis, obtaining $y=A\sin x$. Then shift the whole graph up by $B$ (down if $B<0$), giving $y=A\sin x+B$. The vertical stretch and vertical shift cannot be interchanged: shifting by $B$ first and then stretching gives $A\sin x+AB$, which is generally not $A\sin x+B$.

Horizontal direction: $y=\sin(\omega x)$ compresses $y=\sin x$ horizontally by the factor $\frac{1}{\omega}$ (denser for $\omega>1$, sparser for $0<\omega<1$), and the period changes from $2\pi$ to $\frac{2\pi}{\omega}$. Adding the phase, $$y=\sin(\omega x+\varphi)=\sin\left[\omega\left(x+\frac{\varphi}{\omega}\right)\right].$$ Thus the graph shifts left by $\frac{\varphi}{\omega}$ when $\varphi>0$, or right by $\left|\frac{\varphi}{\omega}\right|$ when $\varphi<0$. The shift is $\frac{\varphi}{\omega}$, not $\varphi$.

Two correct orders: (i) compress horizontally by $x\mapsto\omega x$, then shift left by $\frac{\varphi}{\omega}$, giving $\sin[\omega(x+\frac{\varphi}{\omega})]=\sin(\omega x+\varphi)$; (ii) shift left by $\varphi$ to get $\sin(x+\varphi)$, then compress by $x\mapsto\omega x$, giving $\sin(\omega x+\varphi)$. A common error is to compress first and then shift by $\varphi$, which gives $\sin(\omega x+\omega\varphi)$ and multiplies the phase by $\omega$. For the vertical direction, always stretch first and then shift.

Recovering parameters from a graph: if the maximum is $M$ and the minimum is $m$, then $$B=\frac{M+m}{2},\qquad |A|=\frac{M-m}{2}.$$ The horizontal distance between consecutive maxima (or between a consecutive maximum and minimum) gives one period (or half a period), so $\omega=\frac{2\pi}{T}$. When $|B|<|A|$, the spacing of zeros is generally not half a period unless $B=0$. Taking $A>0$, if a maximum occurs at $x_0$, then $$\omega x_0+\varphi=\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi,$$ and one chooses the value making $\varphi$ lie in a specified range such as $(-\pi,\pi]$. The pair $(A,\varphi)$ is not unique: $(-A,\varphi+\pi)$ represents the same function.

Example: a sinusoid has adjacent maximum $(2,3)$ and minimum $(6,-1)$. Then $$B=\frac{3+(-1)}{2}=1,\qquad |A|=\frac{3-(-1)}{2}=2.$$ The horizontal distance between the maximum and the adjacent minimum is $4$, half a period, so $T=8$ and $\omega=\frac{2\pi}{8}=\frac{\pi}{4}$. Take $A=2$; the maximum at $x=2$ gives $\frac{\pi}{4}\cdot2+\varphi=\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi$, and $k=0$ yields $\varphi=0$. Therefore $$y=2\sin\frac{\pi x}{4}+1.$$

examples.problem: 把 $y = \sin x$ 的图像先横向压缩为原来的 $\frac{1}{2}$，再向右平移 $\frac{\pi}{6}$，得到什么函数？
examples.solution: 横向压缩为 $\frac{1}{2}$ 得到 $y = \sin 2x$；再向右平移 $\frac{\pi}{6}$ 得 $y = \sin 2\left(x - \frac{\pi}{6}\right) = \sin\left(2x - \frac{\pi}{3}\right)$。注意平移量 $\frac{\pi}{6}$ 必须写在括号内乘上 $\omega$。

examples.problem: 某正弦曲线最高点为 $(2, 3)$，最低点为 $(6, -1)$，求它的解析式。
examples.solution: 最大值 $3$、最小值 $-1$，故 $B = \frac{3+(-1)}{2} = 1$，$|A| = \frac{3-(-1)}{2} = 2$。半个周期为 $6 - 2 = 4$，故 $T = 8$，$\omega = \frac{2\pi}{8} = \frac{\pi}{4}$。取 $A = 2$，由 $x = 2$ 处取最大值得 $\frac{\pi}{4}\times 2 + \varphi = \frac{\pi}{2}$，即 $\varphi = 0$。所以 $y = 2\sin\frac{\pi x}{4} + 1$。

fundamental-identities.definition:
**同角三角函数关系**指的是同一个角 $\alpha$ 的不同三角函数之间的恒等式。它们全部来自单位圆上 $x^2 + y^2 = 1$ 这一个事实，却足以把三个函数中的任意一个化归为另一个。

最基本的是**平方关系**：

$$\sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1.$$

它在单位圆中就是勾股定理；两边同时除以 $\cos^2\alpha$ 得到 $1 + \tan^2\alpha = \sec^2\alpha$，除以 $\sin^2\alpha$ 得到 $1 + \cot^2\alpha = \csc^2\alpha$。

其次是**商数关系**：

$$\tan\alpha = \frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha},\qquad \cot\alpha = \frac{\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha}.$$

以及**倒数关系** $\sec\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\cos\alpha}$、$\csc\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\sin\alpha}$、$\cot\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\tan\alpha}$。

这三组关系是「知一求二」的工具：只要知道一个角的某个三角函数值和它所在（或可能的）象限，就能求出其余全部函数值。做这类题时**先定象限判断符号，再用平方关系求绝对值**，是最稳妥的流程。
fundamental-identities.definitionEn:
The **fundamental identities** relate the different trigonometric functions of the same angle $\alpha$. All of them come from the single fact $x^2 + y^2 = 1$ on the unit circle, yet they are enough to convert any one of the functions into another.

The most basic is the **Pythagorean relation**:

$$\sin^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1.$$

On the unit circle this is just Pythagoras' theorem. Dividing both sides by $\cos^2\alpha$ gives $1 + \tan^2\alpha = \sec^2\alpha$, and dividing by $\sin^2\alpha$ gives $1 + \cot^2\alpha = \csc^2\alpha$.

Next is the **quotient relation**:

$$\tan\alpha = \frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha},\qquad \cot\alpha = \frac{\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha}.$$

Finally the **reciprocal relations**: $\sec\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\cos\alpha}$, $\csc\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\sin\alpha}$ and $\cot\alpha = \dfrac{1}{\tan\alpha}$.

Together these form a tool for finding all values from one: knowing a single trigonometric value of an angle and its quadrant, you can recover all the others. The reliable procedure is to **fix the quadrant to determine the signs, then use the Pythagorean relation for the magnitude**.
derivation: 设角 $\alpha$ 的终边与单位圆交于 $P(x,y)$，则 $x=\cos\alpha$、$y=\sin\alpha$，且 $x^2+y^2=1$。代入得 $$\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1,$$ 对一切 $\alpha\in\mathbb{R}$ 成立；这是同角关系的出发点。
商数关系：当 $\cos\alpha\ne0$ 时，$$\tan\alpha=\frac{y}{x}=\frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha};$$ 当 $\sin\alpha\ne0$ 时，$$\cot\alpha=\frac{x}{y}=\frac{\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha}.$$ 两个分母条件不能省略，否则商式无意义。

倒数关系：在分母非零时，$$\sec\alpha= rac{1}{\cos\alpha},\quad \csc\alpha= rac{1}{\sin\alpha}.$$ 此外，当 $	an\alpha$ 有意义且非零时 $\cot\alpha= rac{1}{	an\alpha}$，这等价于 $\sin\alpha
e0$ 且 $\cos\alpha
e0$；而 $\cot\alpha= rac{\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha}$ 本身只要求 $\sin\alpha
e0$。

平方关系的变形：当 $\cos\alpha\ne0$ 时，将 $\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1$ 两边除以 $\cos^2\alpha$，得 $$1+\tan^2\alpha=\sec^2\alpha;$$ 当 $\sin\alpha\ne0$ 时，两边除以 $\sin^2\alpha$，得 $$1+\cot^2\alpha=\csc^2\alpha.$$ 这两条只在相应分母非零的角上成立。

知一求二（开方看象限）：已知 $\sin\alpha=\frac35$ 且 $\alpha$ 在第二象限。由平方关系 $$\cos^2\alpha=1-\frac{9}{25}=\frac{16}{25},$$ 开方得 $|\cos\alpha|=\frac45$；第二象限余弦为负，故 $\cos\alpha=-\frac45$，再由商数关系 $\tan\alpha=\frac{3/5}{-4/5}=-\frac34$。若只说 $\sin\alpha=\frac35$ 而不给象限，则 $\cos\alpha=\pm\frac45$，必须保留两个答案。

常用对称式：令 $t=\sin\alpha+\cos\alpha$，则 $$t^2=1+2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha,$$ 即 $\sin\alpha\cos\alpha=\frac{t^2-1}{2}$。由于 $t=\sqrt2\sin\left(\alpha+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)$，必有 $|t|\le\sqrt2$；用这个代换时不能忘记这一限制，否则会接受不可能的值。
derivationEn: Let the terminal side of angle $\alpha$ meet the unit circle at $P(x,y)$. Then $x=\cos\alpha$, $y=\sin\alpha$ and $x^2+y^2=1$. Substituting gives $$\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1,$$ valid for every $\alpha\in\mathbb{R}$; this is the starting point for all identities between functions of the same angle.

Quotient relations: when $\cos\alpha\ne0$, $$\tan\alpha=\frac{y}{x}=\frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha};$$ when $\sin\alpha\ne0$, $$\cot\alpha=\frac{x}{y}=\frac{\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha}.$$ The non-zero denominator conditions are essential, since otherwise the quotients are undefined.

Reciprocal relations: whenever the denominators are non-zero, $$\sec\alpha= rac{1}{\cos\alpha},\quad \csc\alpha= rac{1}{\sin\alpha}.$$ Moreover, when $	an\alpha$ is defined and non-zero, $\cot\alpha= rac{1}{	an\alpha}$, which is equivalent to $\sin\alpha
e0$ and $\cos\alpha
e0$; by contrast, $\cot\alpha= rac{\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha}$ itself requires only $\sin\alpha
e0$.

Variants of the Pythagorean relation: if $\cos\alpha\ne0$, dividing $\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1$ by $\cos^2\alpha$ gives $$1+\tan^2\alpha=\sec^2\alpha;$$ if $\sin\alpha\ne0$, dividing by $\sin^2\alpha$ gives $$1+\cot^2\alpha=\csc^2\alpha.$$ Each holds only where the corresponding denominator is non-zero.

Finding the other two values (take the sign by quadrant): suppose $\sin\alpha=\frac35$ and $\alpha$ lies in quadrant II. The Pythagorean relation gives $$\cos^2\alpha=1-\frac{9}{25}=\frac{16}{25},$$ so $|\cos\alpha|=\frac45$. Cosine is negative in quadrant II, hence $\cos\alpha=-\frac45$, and the quotient relation gives $\tan\alpha=\frac{3/5}{-4/5}=-\frac34$. If only $\sin\alpha=\frac35$ is given, then $\cos\alpha=\pm\frac45$ and both answers must be retained.

A useful symmetric form: setting $t=\sin\alpha+\cos\alpha$ gives $$t^2=1+2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha,$$ that is, $\sin\alpha\cos\alpha=\frac{t^2-1}{2}$. Since $t=\sqrt2\sin\left(\alpha+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)$, necessarily $|t|\le\sqrt2$; this restriction must not be dropped, or impossible values may be accepted.

examples.problem: 已知 $\tan\alpha = 2$，且 $\alpha$ 是第三象限角，求 $\sin\alpha$ 与 $\cos\alpha$。
examples.solution: 由 $\frac{\sin\alpha}{\cos\alpha} = 2$ 得 $\sin\alpha = 2\cos\alpha$。代入平方关系：$4\cos^2\alpha + \cos^2\alpha = 1$，即 $\cos^2\alpha = \frac{1}{5}$。第三象限中 $\cos\alpha < 0$，故 $\cos\alpha = -\frac{\sqrt{5}}{5}$，$\sin\alpha = -\frac{2\sqrt{5}}{5}$。

examples.problem: 化简 $\dfrac{\sin\alpha}{1-\cos\alpha} + \dfrac{1-\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha}$。
examples.solution: 通分得 $\frac{\sin^2\alpha + (1-\cos\alpha)^2}{\sin\alpha(1-\cos\alpha)} = \frac{\sin^2\alpha + 1 - 2\cos\alpha + \cos^2\alpha}{\sin\alpha(1-\cos\alpha)} = \frac{2 - 2\cos\alpha}{\sin\alpha(1-\cos\alpha)} = \frac{2(1-\cos\alpha)}{\sin\alpha(1-\cos\alpha)} = \frac{2}{\sin\alpha}$。

reduction-formulas.definition:
**诱导公式**（也叫归约公式）是一组把任意角的三角函数值转化为某个锐角三角函数值的公式。有了它们，只需记住 $0$ 到 $\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 之间的函数值，就能算出任何角的函数值。

它们可以按自变量分成四族：$-\alpha$、$\pi \pm \alpha$、$2\pi - \alpha$、以及最「别扭」的 $\dfrac{\pi}{2} \pm \alpha$ 和 $\dfrac{3\pi}{2} \pm \alpha$。前三族的函数名保持不变，第四族则会发生**名称互换**：正弦与余弦互换、正切与余切互换。

统一记忆口诀是：

> **奇变偶不变，符号看象限。**

这里的「$\frac{\pi}{2}$ 的奇数倍还是偶数倍」决定函数名是否改变：$\pi \pm \alpha$ 中的 $\pi$ 是 $\frac{\pi}{2}$ 的 2 倍（偶），函数名不变；$\frac{\pi}{2}\pm\alpha$ 中系数是 1（奇），函数名要变。而「符号看象限」指的是：**把 $\alpha$ 当成锐角**，判断原角落在哪个象限，该象限中原函数的正负就是结果的正负。

本质上看，诱导公式就是单位圆的**对称性**：$-\alpha$ 关于 $x$ 轴对称，$\pi-\alpha$ 关于 $y$ 轴对称，$\pi+\alpha$ 关于原点对称，$\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha$ 关于直线 $y=x$ 对称。
reduction-formulas.definitionEn:
The **reduction formulas** convert the trigonometric value of any angle into that of an acute angle. With them, memorising the values on $\left[0, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]$ is enough to evaluate any angle at all.

They fall into four families by argument: $-\alpha$, $\pi \pm \alpha$, $2\pi - \alpha$, and the trickier $\dfrac{\pi}{2} \pm \alpha$ and $\dfrac{3\pi}{2} \pm \alpha$. The first three keep the function name; the last family **swaps names**: sine with cosine, tangent with cotangent.

The standard mnemonic is:

> **Odd changes, even keeps; the sign follows the quadrant.**

Whether the coefficient of $\frac{\pi}{2}$ is odd or even decides whether the name changes: in $\pi \pm \alpha$ the $\pi$ is twice $\frac{\pi}{2}$ (even), so the name is preserved; in $\frac{\pi}{2}\pm\alpha$ the coefficient is 1 (odd), so the name changes. The sign is found by **pretending $\alpha$ is acute** and asking which quadrant the original angle lies in — the sign of the original function there is the sign of the result.

Geometrically these are just the **symmetries of the unit circle**: $-\alpha$ reflects in the x-axis, $\pi-\alpha$ in the y-axis, $\pi+\alpha$ in the origin, and $\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha$ in the line $y=x$.
derivation: 先用周期性把角化小：$\sin,\cos$ 以 $2\pi$ 为周期，$\tan$ 以 $\pi$ 为周期，因此 $$\sin(x+2k\pi)=\sin x,\quad \cos(x+2k\pi)=\cos x,\quad \tan(x+k\pi)=\tan x.$$ 对任意角，先减去适当的 $2k\pi$（正切减 $k\pi$），把它化到 $[0,2\pi)$ 内，再处理对称。

$-\alpha$ 型：角 $-\alpha$ 的终边与 $\alpha$ 的终边关于 $x$ 轴对称，交点由 $(\cos\alpha,\sin\alpha)$ 变为 $(\cos\alpha,-\sin\alpha)$。故 $$\sin(-\alpha)=-\sin\alpha,\quad \cos(-\alpha)=\cos\alpha,\quad \tan(-\alpha)=-\tan\alpha.$$
$\pi-\alpha$ 型：终边关于 $y$ 轴对称，交点为 $(-\cos\alpha,\sin\alpha)$，故 $$\sin(\pi-\alpha)=\sin\alpha,\quad \cos(\pi-\alpha)=-\cos\alpha,\quad \tan(\pi-\alpha)=-\tan\alpha.$$ 函数名不变，符号由第二象限决定。
$\pi+\alpha$ 型：终边关于原点对称，交点为 $(-\cos\alpha,-\sin\alpha)$，故 $$\sin(\pi+\alpha)=-\sin\alpha,\quad \cos(\pi+\alpha)=-\cos\alpha,\quad \tan(\pi+\alpha)=\tan\alpha.$$ 前两个变号，正切因分子分母同时变号而保持不变。

$\frac{\pi}{2}\pm\alpha$ 型：角 $\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha$ 的终边与 $\alpha$ 的终边关于直线 $y=x$ 对称，交点为 $(\sin\alpha,\cos\alpha)$，故 $$\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)=\cos\alpha,\quad \cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)=\sin\alpha;$$ 角 $\frac{\pi}{2}+\alpha$ 对应点 $(-\sin\alpha,\cos\alpha)$，故 $$\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\alpha\right)=\cos\alpha,\quad \cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\alpha\right)=-\sin\alpha.$$ 名称互换，符号仍看象限。

口诀「奇变偶不变，符号看象限」：把角写成 $k\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}\pm\alpha$。$k$ 为奇数时函数名互换（$\sin\leftrightarrow\cos$，$\tan\leftrightarrow\cot$），$k$ 为偶数时不变；符号则把 $\alpha$ 视为锐角，判断原角所在象限中原函数的正负。例：$$\sin\frac{7\pi}{6}=\sin\left(\pi+\frac{\pi}{6}\right)=-\sin\frac{\pi}{6}=-\frac12,$$ $$\cos\frac{5\pi}{4}=\cos\left(\pi+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=-\cos\frac{\pi}{4}=-\frac{\sqrt2}{2},$$ $$\sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)=-\cos\alpha.$$ 最后一条中 $k=3$ 为奇数，名称变为余弦；$\alpha$ 为锐角时 $\frac{3\pi}{2}-\alpha$ 在第三象限，原正弦为负，故添负号。口诀中「$\alpha$ 为锐角」只是判断符号的辅助，公式本身对使两边有定义的任意 $\alpha$ 成立。
derivationEn: First reduce the angle by periodicity: $\sin$ and $\cos$ have period $2\pi$, while $\tan$ has period $\pi$, so $$\sin(x+2k\pi)=\sin x,\quad \cos(x+2k\pi)=\cos x,\quad \tan(x+k\pi)=\tan x.$$ For any angle, subtract a suitable $2k\pi$ (or $k\pi$ for tangent) to land in $[0,2\pi)$, then handle the symmetry.

The $-\alpha$ family: the terminal side of $-\alpha$ is the reflection of that of $\alpha$ in the x-axis, so the intersection point changes from $(\cos\alpha,\sin\alpha)$ to $(\cos\alpha,-\sin\alpha)$. Hence $$\sin(-\alpha)=-\sin\alpha,\quad \cos(-\alpha)=\cos\alpha,\quad \tan(-\alpha)=-\tan\alpha.$$

The $\pi-\alpha$ family: the terminal side is reflected in the y-axis and the intersection point is $(-\cos\alpha,\sin\alpha)$. Hence $$\sin(\pi-\alpha)=\sin\alpha,\quad \cos(\pi-\alpha)=-\cos\alpha,\quad \tan(\pi-\alpha)=-\tan\alpha.$$ The function names are unchanged, and the signs are those of quadrant II.

The $\pi+\alpha$ family: the terminal side is reflected in the origin and the intersection point is $(-\cos\alpha,-\sin\alpha)$. Hence $$\sin(\pi+\alpha)=-\sin\alpha,\quad \cos(\pi+\alpha)=-\cos\alpha,\quad \tan(\pi+\alpha)=\tan\alpha.$$ The first two change sign, while tangent is unchanged because numerator and denominator change sign together.

The $\frac{\pi}{2}\pm\alpha$ family: the terminal side of $\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha$ is the reflection of that of $\alpha$ in the line $y=x$, with intersection point $(\sin\alpha,\cos\alpha)$. Hence $$\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)=\cos\alpha,\quad \cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)=\sin\alpha.$$ The angle $\frac{\pi}{2}+\alpha$ corresponds to $(-\sin\alpha,\cos\alpha)$, so $$\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\alpha\right)=\cos\alpha,\quad \cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+\alpha\right)=-\sin\alpha.$$ The names swap, and the signs still follow the quadrant.

The mnemonic «odd changes, even keeps; the sign follows the quadrant»: write the angle as $k\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}\pm\alpha$. If $k$ is odd, swap the function name ($\sin\leftrightarrow\cos$, $\tan\leftrightarrow\cot$); if $k$ is even, keep it. For the sign, treat $\alpha$ as acute and take the sign of the original function in the quadrant where the original angle lies. Examples: $$\sin\frac{7\pi}{6}=\sin\left(\pi+\frac{\pi}{6}\right)=-\sin\frac{\pi}{6}=-\frac12,$$ $$\cos\frac{5\pi}{4}=\cos\left(\pi+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)=-\cos\frac{\pi}{4}=-\frac{\sqrt2}{2},$$ $$\sin\left(\frac{3\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)=-\cos\alpha.$$ In the last formula $k=3$ is odd, so the name becomes cosine; for acute $\alpha$, the angle $\frac{3\pi}{2}-\alpha$ lies in quadrant III, where the original sine is negative, hence the minus sign. The instruction to treat $\alpha$ as acute is only a device for fixing signs; the formula itself holds for every $\alpha$ for which both sides are defined.

trigonometric-identities.definition:
**三角恒等变换**研究如何把一个三角函数式变形为另一个在数学上等价但形式更简单的式子。核心公式是**和差角公式**，其余大部分公式都由它推出。

和差角公式说：正弦的加法里正弦与余弦「交叉」，余弦的加法里出现减号：

$$\sin(\alpha \pm \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta \pm \cos\alpha\sin\beta,$$

$$\cos(\alpha \pm \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta \mp \sin\alpha\sin\beta.$$

正切的和角公式由它们相除得到，注意 $\cos\alpha\cos\beta \neq 0$ 且分母不为零。

令 $\beta = \alpha$ 就得到**二倍角公式**：$\sin 2\alpha = 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha$、$\cos 2\alpha = \cos^2\alpha - \sin^2\alpha = 1 - 2\sin^2\alpha = 2\cos^2\alpha - 1$。余弦的三种写法极其有用，因为它们能把二次式降次，是积分与解方程中的常用手段。

把二倍角公式反用，得到**降幂公式** $\sin^2\alpha = \dfrac{1-\cos 2\alpha}{2}$、$\cos^2\alpha = \dfrac{1+\cos 2\alpha}{2}$；再把 $\alpha$ 换成 $\dfrac{\alpha}{2}$ 就得到半角公式。

最后是**辅助角公式**：把 $a\sin x + b\cos x$（$a,b$ 不同时为零）合并成一个正弦，其中 $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$ 是振幅，$\varphi$ 由 $\sin\varphi=\dfrac{b}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$、$\cos\varphi=\dfrac{a}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$ 确定（只写 $\tan\varphi=\dfrac{b}{a}$ 不够，辐角可差 $\pi$ 使整体变号）。这是求三角函数最值与周期的利器。
trigonometric-identities.definitionEn:
**Trigonometric transformations** study how to rewrite a trigonometric expression into an equivalent but simpler form. The key formulas are the **sum and difference formulas**, from which most of the rest follow.

In the sum formulas the sine «crosses» sine with cosine, while the cosine formula carries a minus sign:

$$\sin(\alpha \pm \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta \pm \cos\alpha\sin\beta,$$

$$\cos(\alpha \pm \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta \mp \sin\alpha\sin\beta.$$

The tangent sum formula follows by dividing them, provided $\cos\alpha\cos\beta \neq 0$ and the denominator is non-zero.

Setting $\beta = \alpha$ gives the **double-angle formulas**: $\sin 2\alpha = 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha$ and $\cos 2\alpha = \cos^2\alpha - \sin^2\alpha = 1 - 2\sin^2\alpha = 2\cos^2\alpha - 1$. The three forms of the cosine are especially useful because they reduce a square to a linear term, a staple in integration and in solving equations.

Running the double-angle formulas backwards gives the **power-reduction formulas** $\sin^2\alpha = \dfrac{1-\cos 2\alpha}{2}$ and $\cos^2\alpha = \dfrac{1+\cos 2\alpha}{2}$; replacing $\alpha$ by $\dfrac{\alpha}{2}$ then yields the half-angle formulas.

Finally the **auxiliary-angle formula** merges $a\sin x + b\cos x$ (with $a,b$ not both zero) into one sine, with amplitude $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$ and $\varphi$ fixed by $\sin\varphi=\dfrac{b}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$, $\cos\varphi=\dfrac{a}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}$ (the single equation $\tan\varphi=b/a$ would not pin down $\varphi$, which may differ by $\pi$ and flip the sign). It is the sharpest tool for finding extrema and periods of trigonometric expressions.
derivation:
先证余弦的差角公式。设单位圆上 $P(\cos\alpha,\sin\alpha)$、$Q(\cos\beta,\sin\beta)$，则弦长平方为
$$\begin{aligned}|PQ|^2&=(\cos\alpha-\cos\beta)^2+(\sin\alpha-\sin\beta)^2\\&=2-2(\cos\alpha\cos\beta+\sin\alpha\sin\beta).\end{aligned}$$
把 $P,Q$ 同时旋转 $-\beta$，$Q$ 落到 $(1,0)$，$P$ 落到 $(\cos(\alpha-\beta),\sin(\alpha-\beta))$；旋转保持距离，故
$$|PQ|^2=2-2\cos(\alpha-\beta).$$
两式相等得 $\cos(\alpha-\beta)=\cos\alpha\cos\beta+\sin\alpha\sin\beta$，对一切 $\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb R$ 成立。

在差角公式中把 $\beta$ 换成 $-\beta$，并用 $\cos(-\beta)=\cos\beta$、$\sin(-\beta)=-\sin\beta$，得
$$\cos(\alpha+\beta)=\cos\alpha\cos\beta-\sin\alpha\sin\beta.$$
两式对一切实数 $\alpha,\beta$ 成立，无需额外限制。

由诱导公式 $\sin\theta=\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)$，分别取 $\theta=\alpha+\beta$ 与 $\theta=\alpha-\beta$：
$$\begin{aligned}\sin(\alpha+\beta)&=\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha-\beta\right)=\cos\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)-\beta\right)\\&=\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta,\end{aligned}$$
同理 $\sin(\alpha-\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta-\cos\alpha\sin\beta$。合并写为 $\sin(\alpha\pm\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta\pm\cos\alpha\sin\beta$。

正切由正弦与余弦之商得到：
$$ egin{aligned}	an(\alpha\pm eta)&= rac{\sin(\alpha\pm eta)}{\cos(\alpha\pm eta)}\&= rac{	an\alpha\pm	an eta}{1\mp	an\alpha	an eta},\end{aligned}$$
第二步是分子分母同除以 $\cos\alpha\cos eta$。成立条件为 $\cos\alpha\cos eta
e0$（保证 $	an\alpha,	an eta$ 有定义）且 $1\mp	an\alpha	an eta
e0$（保证分母不为零，等价于 $\cos(\alpha\pm eta)
e0$）。

令 $\beta=\alpha$，由和角公式得二倍角公式：
$$\sin2\alpha=2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha,\qquad \cos2\alpha=\cos^2\alpha-\sin^2\alpha.$$
再用 $\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1$ 消去一个平方，得到余弦的另外两种等价形式：
$$\cos2\alpha=2\cos^2\alpha-1=1-2\sin^2\alpha.$$
三式对一切实数 $\alpha$ 成立，选用哪一种取决于要保留 $\sin^2\alpha$ 还是 $\cos^2\alpha$。

把二倍角公式反解，得降幂公式：
$$\sin^2\alpha=\frac{1-\cos2\alpha}{2},\qquad \cos^2\alpha=\frac{1+\cos2\alpha}{2}.$$
将 $\alpha$ 换成 $\frac{\alpha}{2}$ 得半角公式；开方时必须按 $\frac{\alpha}{2}$ 所在象限取符号：
$$\begin{aligned}\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}&=\pm\sqrt{\frac{1-\cos\alpha}{2}},\\ \cos\frac{\alpha}{2}&=\pm\sqrt{\frac{1+\cos\alpha}{2}}.\end{aligned}$$
例如 $\sin15^\circ=\sin(45^\circ-30^\circ)=\frac{\sqrt6-\sqrt2}{4}$，可作为和差角公式的数值校验。
derivationEn:
First prove the cosine difference formula. On the unit circle take $P(\cos\alpha,\sin\alpha)$ and $Q(\cos\beta,\sin\beta)$. Then
$$\begin{aligned}|PQ|^2&=(\cos\alpha-\cos\beta)^2+(\sin\alpha-\sin\beta)^2\\&=2-2(\cos\alpha\cos\beta+\sin\alpha\sin\beta).\end{aligned}$$
Rotating both points by $-\beta$ sends $Q$ to $(1,0)$ and $P$ to $(\cos(\alpha-\beta),\sin(\alpha-\beta))$; rotation preserves distance, so
$$|PQ|^2=2-2\cos(\alpha-\beta).$$
Equating the two expressions gives $\cos(\alpha-\beta)=\cos\alpha\cos\beta+\sin\alpha\sin\beta$ for all $\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb R$.

Replace $\beta$ by $-\beta$ in the difference formula and use $\cos(-\beta)=\cos\beta$, $\sin(-\beta)=-\sin\beta$:
$$\cos(\alpha+\beta)=\cos\alpha\cos\beta-\sin\alpha\sin\beta.$$
Both formulas hold for all real $\alpha,\beta$ with no further restriction.

Using the reduction identity $\sin\theta=\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)$ with $\theta=\alpha+\beta$ and $\theta=\alpha-\beta$:
$$\begin{aligned}\sin(\alpha+\beta)&=\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha-\beta\right)=\cos\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)-\beta\right)\\&=\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta,\end{aligned}$$
and similarly $\sin(\alpha-\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta-\cos\alpha\sin\beta$. Hence $\sin(\alpha\pm\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta\pm\cos\alpha\sin\beta$.

Tangent is the quotient of sine and cosine:
$$ egin{aligned}	an(\alpha\pm eta)&= rac{\sin(\alpha\pm eta)}{\cos(\alpha\pm eta)}\&= rac{	an\alpha\pm	an eta}{1\mp	an\alpha	an eta},\end{aligned}$$
where the second equality comes from dividing numerator and denominator by $\cos\alpha\cos eta$. The identity requires $\cos\alpha\cos eta
e0$ (so that $	an\alpha,	an eta$ are defined) and $1\mp	an\alpha	an eta
e0$ (so the denominator is nonzero, equivalently $\cos(\alpha\pm eta)
e0$).

Set $\beta=\alpha$ in the addition formulas to obtain the double-angle formulas:
$$\sin2\alpha=2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha,\qquad \cos2\alpha=\cos^2\alpha-\sin^2\alpha.$$
Eliminating one square via $\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1$ gives the other two equivalent forms:
$$\cos2\alpha=2\cos^2\alpha-1=1-2\sin^2\alpha.$$
All three hold for every real $\alpha$; the choice depends on whether $\sin^2\alpha$ or $\cos^2\alpha$ is to be kept.

Solving the double-angle formulas backwards gives the power-reduction formulas:
$$\sin^2\alpha=\frac{1-\cos2\alpha}{2},\qquad \cos^2\alpha=\frac{1+\cos2\alpha}{2}.$$
Replacing $\alpha$ by $\frac{\alpha}{2}$ yields the half-angle formulas; when taking square roots, the sign must follow the quadrant of $\frac{\alpha}{2}$:
$$\begin{aligned}\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}&=\pm\sqrt{\frac{1-\cos\alpha}{2}},\\ \cos\frac{\alpha}{2}&=\pm\sqrt{\frac{1+\cos\alpha}{2}}.\end{aligned}$$
For instance, $\sin15^\circ=\sin(45^\circ-30^\circ)=\frac{\sqrt6-\sqrt2}{4}$ provides a numerical check of the addition formula.

examples.problem: 求 $\sin 75^\circ$ 的精确值。
examples.solution: $\sin 75^\circ = \sin(45^\circ + 30^\circ) = \sin 45^\circ\cos 30^\circ + \cos 45^\circ\sin 30^\circ = \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{6}+\sqrt{2}}{4}$。

examples.problem: 已知 $\sin\alpha = \frac{3}{5}$，$\alpha \in \left(\frac{\pi}{2}, \pi\right)$，求 $\sin 2\alpha$ 与 $\cos 2\alpha$。
examples.solution: 由 $\alpha$ 在第二象限得 $\cos\alpha = -\sqrt{1-\frac{9}{25}} = -\frac{4}{5}$。于是 $\sin 2\alpha = 2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha = 2\times\frac{3}{5}\times\left(-\frac{4}{5}\right) = -\frac{24}{25}$；$\cos 2\alpha = 1 - 2\sin^2\alpha = 1 - \frac{18}{25} = \frac{7}{25}$。

examples.problem: 求函数 $y = \sin x + \sqrt{3}\cos x$ 的最大值与最小正周期。
examples.solution: 由辅助角公式，$y = \sqrt{1+3}\,\sin\left(x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right) = 2\sin\left(x+\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$，其中 $\tan\varphi = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{1}$ 取 $\varphi = \frac{\pi}{3}$。故最大值为 $2$，最小值 $-2$，最小正周期 $T = 2\pi$。

trig-properties.definition:
**三角函数的性质**指的是正弦、余弦、正切函数在定义域上表现出的整体特征，主要包括周期性、奇偶性、单调性、对称性和最值。掌握这些性质，就能不画图而直接判断函数的走势。

**周期性**是最本质的特征。若存在非零常数 $T$ 使 $f(x+T) = f(x)$ 对定义域内一切 $x$ 成立，则称 $f$ 为周期函数，$T$ 为它的周期，其中最小的正数叫**最小正周期**。$\sin$ 与 $\cos$ 的最小正周期都是 $2\pi$，$\tan$ 的是 $\pi$。对复合函数 $y = A\sin(\omega x + \varphi) + B$，最小正周期为 $\dfrac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$。

**奇偶性**上，$\sin$ 是奇函数（关于原点对称），$\cos$ 是偶函数（关于 $y$ 轴对称），$\tan$ 也是奇函数。它们共同的一点是图像具有**平移对称性与反射对称性**：正弦图像关于直线 $x = \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi$ 轴对称，同时关于点 $(k\pi, 0)$ 中心对称。

**单调性**需要在同一个单调区间内讨论。特别注意：$\tan$ 在每个小区间 $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi, \frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi\right)$ 上是增函数，但在整个定义域上**不是**增函数——这是最容易被忽视的陷阱。

研究一般三角函数的流程通常是：先用恒等变换把它化为 $y = A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B$ 的标准形，再由标准形读出周期、最值、单调区间和对称轴。
trig-properties.definitionEn:
The **properties of trigonometric functions** are the overall features that sine, cosine and tangent exhibit on their domains: periodicity, parity, monotonicity, symmetry and extrema. Knowing them lets you read the behaviour of a graph without drawing it.

**Periodicity** is the essential feature. If a non-zero constant $T$ satisfies $f(x+T) = f(x)$ for all $x$, then $f$ is periodic and $T$ is a period; the smallest positive one is the **least positive period**. The sine and cosine both have least positive period $2\pi$, the tangent $\pi$. For a composite $y = A\sin(\omega x + \varphi) + B$ the least positive period is $\dfrac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$.

As for **parity**, $\sin$ is odd (symmetric about the origin), $\cos$ is even (symmetric about the y-axis) and $\tan$ is also odd. What they share is **reflective and central symmetry**: the sine graph has axes of symmetry $x = \frac{\pi}{2} + k\pi$ and centres of symmetry $(k\pi, 0)$.

**Monotonicity** must be discussed inside a single monotonic interval. In particular, $\tan$ increases on each interval $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi, \frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi\right)$ but is **not** increasing on its entire domain — the most commonly missed trap.

The usual workflow for studying a general trigonometric function is: first reduce it to the standard form $y = A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B$ by identities, then read off the period, the extrema, the monotonic intervals and the axes of symmetry.
derivation: 设 $f$ 的定义域为 $D$。若存在非零常数 $T$，使对一切 $x\in D$ 都有 $x+T\in D$ 且 $f(x+T)=f(x)$，则称 $f$ 为周期函数，$T$ 为一个周期；若存在最小的正周期，则称其为最小正周期。$\sin x$ 与 $\cos x$ 的最小正周期为 $2\pi$，$\tan x$ 的为 $\pi$；常数函数是周期函数，但没有最小正周期。

证明 $\sin$ 的最小正周期是 $2\pi$。设 $T>0$ 为周期。取 $x=0$ 得 $\sin T=0$，故 $T=k\pi$（$k$ 为正整数）；再取 $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ 得 $\sin(\frac{\pi}{2}+T)=1$，即 $\cos T=1$，故 $T=2m\pi$。最小的正值为 $2\pi$，且 $\sin(x+2\pi)=\sin x$ 确实成立。$\cos$ 由 $x=0$ 处 $\cos T=1$ 直接得 $T=2k\pi$；$\tan$ 由 $\tan(x+\pi)=\tan x$ 及 $x=0$ 处 $\tan T=0$ 得最小正周期 $\pi$。

对 $y=A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B$（$A\ne0$，$\omega\ne0$），最小正周期为 $$T=\frac{2\pi}{|\omega|}.$$ 先验证它是周期：$$\begin{aligned}\sin\bigl(\omega(x+T)+\varphi\bigr)&=\sin\bigl(\omega x+\varphi+2\pi\operatorname{sgn}\omega\bigr)\\&=\sin(\omega x+\varphi).\end{aligned}$$ 再证最小性：若 $T>0$ 是周期，则对一切 $u=\omega x+\varphi$ 有 $\sin(u+\omega T)=\sin u$，由第 2 步得 $\omega T=2k\pi$，故 $T\ge\frac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$。

奇偶性：$\sin(-x)=-\sin x$，$\cos(-x)=\cos x$，$\tan(-x)=-\tan x$，所以 $\sin,\tan$ 为奇函数，$\cos$ 为偶函数。对称性可用方程验证：$\sin(2a-x)=\sin x$ 对一切 $x$ 成立，等价于 $$2\cos a\sin(a-x)=0\ \text{对一切 }x,$$ 故 $\cos a=0$，即 $a=\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi$，这些直线是正弦图像的对称轴。令 $\sin(2a-x)=-\sin x$ 得 $\sin a=0$，即 $a=k\pi$，故对称中心为 $(k\pi,0)$。同理，$\cos$ 的对称轴为 $x=k\pi$，对称中心为 $(\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi,0)$；$\tan$ 的对称中心为 $(\frac{k\pi}{2},0)$。

单调性必须在单个区间内讨论：$$\begin{aligned}\sin x:&\quad \text{增}\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi,\ \frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi\right],\\&\quad \text{减}\left[\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi,\ \frac{3\pi}{2}+2k\pi\right];\\[2pt]\cos x:&\quad \text{减}\left[2k\pi,\ (2k+1)\pi\right],\\&\quad \text{增}\left[(2k+1)\pi,\ 2k\pi+2\pi\right].\end{aligned}$$ $\tan x$ 在每个 $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi,\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi\right)$ 内递增，但在整个定义域上不是增函数：$\frac{\pi}{4}<\frac{3\pi}{4}$，而 $\tan\frac{\pi}{4}=1>-1=\tan\frac{3\pi}{4}$。

最值：$y=A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B$ 的最大值为 $B+|A|$，最小值为 $B-|A|$；最大值在 $\sin(\omega x+\varphi)=\operatorname{sgn}(A)$ 时取得，最小值在 $\sin(\omega x+\varphi)=-\operatorname{sgn}(A)$ 时取得（或分 $A>0$、$A<0$ 讨论）。研究一般三角函数的流程是：先用和差角、二倍角或辅助角公式化为标准形，再由标准形读出周期、值域、单调区间与对称轴。例如 $$y=2\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{3}-2x\right)=-2\sin\left(2x-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$$ 的周期为 $\pi$，值域为 $[-2,2]$，递增区间由 $\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi\le2x-\frac{\pi}{3}\le\frac{3\pi}{2}+2k\pi$ 解出，即 $\frac{5\pi}{12}+k\pi\le x\le\frac{11\pi}{12}+k\pi$。
derivationEn: Let $f$ have domain $D$. If there is a non-zero constant $T$ such that $x+T\in D$ and $f(x+T)=f(x)$ for every $x\in D$, then $f$ is periodic and $T$ is a period; if a smallest positive period exists, it is the least positive period. The least positive period of $\sin x$ and $\cos x$ is $2\pi$, and that of $\tan x$ is $\pi$. Constant functions are periodic but have no least positive period.

Prove that the least positive period of $\sin$ is $2\pi$. Let $T>0$ be a period. Taking $x=0$ gives $\sin T=0$, so $T=k\pi$ for a positive integer $k$; taking $x=\frac{\pi}{2}$ gives $\sin(\frac{\pi}{2}+T)=1$, i.e. $\cos T=1$, so $T=2m\pi$. The smallest positive value is $2\pi$, and $\sin(x+2\pi)=\sin x$ indeed holds. For $\cos$, $x=0$ gives $\cos T=1$, hence $T=2k\pi$. For $\tan$, $\tan(x+\pi)=\tan x$ together with $\tan T=0$ at $x=0$ gives least positive period $\pi$.

For $y=A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B$ with $A\ne0$ and $\omega\ne0$, the least positive period is $$T=\frac{2\pi}{|\omega|}.$$ First check that it is a period: $$\begin{aligned}\sin\bigl(\omega(x+T)+\varphi\bigr)&=\sin\bigl(\omega x+\varphi+2\pi\operatorname{sgn}\omega\bigr)\\&=\sin(\omega x+\varphi).\end{aligned}$$ For minimality, if $T>0$ is a period, then $\sin(u+\omega T)=\sin u$ for all $u=\omega x+\varphi$; Step 2 gives $\omega T=2k\pi$, hence $T\ge\frac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$.

Parity: $\sin(-x)=-\sin x$, $\cos(-x)=\cos x$ and $\tan(-x)=-\tan x$, so $\sin$ and $\tan$ are odd while $\cos$ is even. Symmetry can be checked by equations: $\sin(2a-x)=\sin x$ for all $x$ is equivalent to $$2\cos a\sin(a-x)=0\ \text{for all }x,$$ hence $\cos a=0$, i.e. $a=\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi$; these lines are the axes of symmetry of the sine graph. Setting $\sin(2a-x)=-\sin x$ gives $\sin a=0$, i.e. $a=k\pi$, so the centres of symmetry are $(k\pi,0)$. Similarly, $\cos$ has axes $x=k\pi$ and centres $(\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi,0)$; $\tan$ has centres $(\frac{k\pi}{2},0)$.

Monotonicity must be discussed on a single interval: $$\begin{aligned}\sin x:&\quad \text{increasing on }\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi,\ \frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi\right],\\&\quad \text{decreasing on }\left[\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi,\ \frac{3\pi}{2}+2k\pi\right];\\[2pt]\cos x:&\quad \text{decreasing on }\left[2k\pi,\ (2k+1)\pi\right],\\&\quad \text{increasing on }\left[(2k+1)\pi,\ 2k\pi+2\pi\right].\end{aligned}$$ $\tan x$ increases on each interval $\left(-\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi,\frac{\pi}{2}+k\pi\right)$ but is not increasing on its whole domain: $\frac{\pi}{4}<\frac{3\pi}{4}$, yet $\tan\frac{\pi}{4}=1>-1=\tan\frac{3\pi}{4}$.

Extrema: $y=A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+B$ has maximum $B+|A|$ and minimum $B-|A|$; the maximum is attained when $\sin(\omega x+\varphi)=\operatorname{sgn}(A)$ and the minimum when $\sin(\omega x+\varphi)=-\operatorname{sgn}(A)$ (or split into $A>0$ and $A<0$). The standard workflow is to reduce a general trigonometric function to this form using sum-difference, double-angle or auxiliary-angle formulas, then read off the period, range, monotonic intervals and symmetry axes. For example, $$y=2\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{3}-2x\right)=-2\sin\left(2x-\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$$ has period $\pi$ and range $[-2,2]$, and its increasing intervals follow from $\frac{\pi}{2}+2k\pi\le2x-\frac{\pi}{3}\le\frac{3\pi}{2}+2k\pi$, namely $\frac{5\pi}{12}+k\pi\le x\le\frac{11\pi}{12}+k\pi$.
